description: This file defines API routes for managing reference data including rate cards and complexity defaults. It provides endpoints for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting these records, utilizing FastAPI and SQLAlchemy.

methods.name: RateCard _get_rate_or_404(db: Session, rate_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves a RateCard by ID or raises a 404 HTTPException if not found.

methods.name: ComplexityDefaults _get_complexity_or_404(db: Session, defaults_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves a ComplexityDefaults record by ID or raises a 404 HTTPException if not found.

methods.name: List[RateCard] list_rates(db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Returns a list of all rate cards, ordered by role.

methods.name: RateCard create_rate(payload: RateCardCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Creates a new rate card with provided data.

methods.name: RateCard get_rate(rate_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Fetches a specific rate card by ID.

methods.name: RateCard update_rate(rate_id: int, payload: RateCardUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Updates fields of a rate card identified by ID.

methods.name: None delete_rate(rate_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Deletes a rate card by ID.

methods.name: ComplexityDefaults create_complexity_defaults( payload: ComplexityDefaultsCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Creates a new complexity defaults record.

methods.name: ComplexityDefaults get_complexity_defaults(defaults_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Fetches a complexity defaults record by ID.

methods.name: ComplexityDefaults update_complexity_defaults( defaults_id: int, payload: ComplexityDefaultsUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Updates fields of a complexity defaults record.

methods.name: None delete_complexity_defaults(defaults_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Deletes a complexity defaults record by ID.
